ctx.x: So when I went to Preservation Hall, they told me, said, "Well, play it straight." That's what Jaffe told me. I said, "What do you mean 'play it straight'?" He said, "They just want you to play a straight beat." I said, "I don't play a straight beat. If feel it, (?) it needs a little rhythm in there." I ain't rushing tempos. I don't want to sell(?) myself, you dig? Because usually, when you want to play (?), you (?) you don't know to do that. Just play straight like you don't know what you're doing. That's what…
